name: Immunoglobulin A (IgA)
short_description: Secretory IgA — two Y-shaped IgA monomers joined tail-to-tail at their Fc stems by a J-chain, wrapped in a protective secretory component picked up while crossing the mucosal epithelium; the guardian antibody of saliva, tears, gut and breast milk.
